name: ml-project
description: Monorepo runner for Local-Tune and LocalQR

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "LOCAL-TUNE,LOCALQR" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix Local-Tune" "npm run dev --prefix LocalQR"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Local-Tune && npm install --prefix LocalQR
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix Local-Tune && npm run build --prefix LocalQR
